Hardware & Technology Procurement

We source the business technology your teams need, including computers, servers, networking equipment, and barcode and labeling hardware, and deliver it configured and ready to use.

Request a Quotation →What we deliver

SOUND FAMILIAR?

Problems we solve.

  • Buying equipment from several vendors with no one accountable
  • Devices that arrive unconfigured and take days to set up
  • Barcode printers and scanners that do not work with your systems
  • Procurement teams that need formal quotations, invoices, and tax documents

WHAT WE DELIVER

Scope of work.

The exact scope, schedule, and price are confirmed in a written quotation.

Computers and workstations

Business laptops, desktops, and monitors specified for each role.

Servers and storage

Servers, storage, and backup appliances sized for your workloads.

Networking equipment

Routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless access points.

Barcode scanners and terminals

Handheld scanners and mobile terminals for receiving, picking, and stock counts.

Thermal and label printers

Barcode, shipping-label, and receipt printers, with labels and ribbons for ongoing operations.

Peripherals and accessories

UPS units, docking stations, peripherals, and cabling.

We source through established distributors in Indonesia and recommend brands based on your requirements, budget, and local availability. We describe a brand relationship as a partnership only where an official one exists.

HOW AN ENGAGEMENT WORKS

From first conversation to handover.

  1. 01

    Requirements

    Tell us what you need, for which users, sites, and systems.

  2. 02

    Specification & quotation

    We recommend models and send a formal quotation with delivery times.

  3. 03

    Procure & configure

    We order, receive, and configure the equipment for your environment.

  4. 04

    Deliver & install

    We deliver to your sites and install or hand over, with warranty support.

QUESTIONS

Common questions.

Used in: Warehousing & Logistics, Corporate Offices

Which brands do you supply?

We recommend brands based on your requirements, budget, and availability in Indonesia, and confirm exact models in the quotation.

Can you follow our procurement process?

Yes. We work with formal quotations, purchase orders, invoices, and tax invoices, and can register as a vendor in your system.

Do you configure equipment before delivery?

Yes, where agreed. Computers, network equipment, and barcode devices can be configured so they work on arrival.
